chunks: Muhammad ibn Umar narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn al-Husayn narrated to us. He said: Ahmad ibn Ghanam ibn Hakim narrated to us. He said: Shurayh ibn Maslama narrated to us. He said: Ibrahim ibn Yusuf narrated to us from Abd al-Jabbar from al-A'sha al-Thaqafi from Abu al-Sadiq.
He said: Ali (peace be upon him) said to me: This verse is for us or about us:
'And We wish to confer favour upon those who were oppressed in the land and make them Imams and make them the inheritors.' [28:5]

key_terms.أئمة: Imams — divinely guided leaders from the Prophet's household
key_terms.استضعفوا: Those who were oppressed/deemed weak — referring to the Ahlulbayt who faced oppression
key_terms.الوارثين: The inheritors — those who inherit the earth, leadership, and prophethood

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about Quran 28:5 and its application to the Ahlulbayt?
ai.summary: Abu al-Sadiq reports that Imam Ali (peace be upon him) personally told him that Quran 28:5 — the verse about God's intention to favour those oppressed in the land and make them Imams and inheritors — applies specifically to the Ahlulbayt. This hadith was transmitted through a chain of narrators in the assembly of Sheikh al-Saduq held in 368 AH. The claim reflects the Shia theological position that the Imams from the Prophet's household are the divinely appointed inheritors of religious and political authority.
